need: _observed must say which leading bytes are a JPEG, PNG or WEBP signature (A1 order 6), and prepare_photo which formats the image library may open (A2 rule 2); neither list has a home.
candidate_values: JPEG ff d8 ff at 0; PNG 89 50 4e 47 0d 0a 1a 0a at 0; WEBP RIFF at 0 and WEBP at 8 (the prototype checks only RIFF, which a WAV file also begins with)
Pillow format names JPEG, PNG, WEBP

sources.quote: | 6 | does not begin with a JPEG, PNG or WEBP signature | `rejected` | `unsupported_format` |
2. The source may be JPEG, PNG or WEBP.

homes_considered.home: rules.data_provider_backend.constants: SOURCE_FORMATS and a SOURCE_SIGNATURES record table

homes_considered.why_not: changes the meaning of A1 order 6: a damaged header would be rejected at scan

owner_decision.decision: A8 gains SOURCE_FORMATS (the Pillow format names) and a record table SOURCE_SIGNATURES of format, byte offset and bytes in hexadecimal, WEBP needing both of its rows; A1 order 6 keeps its meaning
